936	    const applyLift = (nextLift: number) => {
937	      const rounded = Math.max(0, Math.round(nextLift));
938	      if (Math.abs(rounded - currentLift) < 2) return;
939	      currentLift = rounded;
940	      if (rounded > 0) {
941	        root.style.setProperty("--mobile-keyboard-lift", `${rounded}px`);
942	      } else {
943	        root.style.removeProperty("--mobile-keyboard-lift");
944	      }

947	    const update = () => {
948	      raf = 0;
949	      const element = focusedElement;
950	      if (!element || document.activeElement !== element || !mobileMq.matches || !viewport) {
951	        applyLift(0);
952	        return;
953	      }
954	
955	      const keyboardTop = viewport.offsetTop + viewport.height;
956	      const keyboardInset = Math.max(0, window.innerHeight - viewport.height - viewport.offsetTop);
957	      const targetRect = getKeyboardTargetRect(element);

959	
960	      if (keyboardInset < 80) {

963	      }

965	      const naturalBottom = targetRect.bottom + currentLift;

973	    };

977	      if (!isKeyboardEditableElement(target)) return;

979	      requestUpdate();
980	    };
981	
982	    const handleFocusOut = () => {
983	      focusedElement = null;
984	      applyLift(0);
985	    };
986	
987	    const handleCaretMove = () => {
988	      if (focusedElement) requestUpdate();
989	    };
990	
991	    const handleViewportChange = () => {
992	      if (focusedElement) requestUpdate();
993	    };
994	
995	    document.addEventListener("focusin", handleFocusIn);
996	    document.addEventListener("focusout", handleFocusOut);

998	    document.addEventListener("keyup", handleCaretMove, true);

1000	    viewport?.addEventListener("resize", handleViewportChange);
1001	    viewport?.addEventListener("scroll", handleViewportChange);

1003	    return () => {
1004	      if (raf) window.cancelAnimationFrame(raf);

1010	      viewport?.removeEventListener("resize", handleViewportChange);
1011	      viewport?.removeEventListener("scroll", handleViewportChange);
1012	      root.style.removeProperty("--mobile-keyboard-lift");
1013	    };

143	export function clearMascotToolHistoryMessages(nextMessages: MascotMsg[]): ClearMascotToolHistoryResult {
144	    let deletedMessages = 0;
145	    let cleanedMessages = 0;
146	    const cleanedMessagesList: MascotMsg[] = [];
147	
148	    for (const msg of nextMessages) {
149	        if (isMascotToolHistoryMessage(msg)) {
150	            deletedMessages += 1;
151	            continue;
152	        }
153	
154	        if (!hasMascotNativeToolReplayMetadata(msg)) {
155	            cleanedMessagesList.push(msg);
156	            continue;
157	        }
158	
159	        const cleaned: MascotMsg = { ...msg };
160	        delete cleaned.toolCalls;
161	        delete cleaned.reasoning;
162	        delete cleaned.openRouterReasoningDetails;
163	
164	        if (msg.role === "mascot" && !hasVisibleMascotPayload(cleaned)) {
165	            deletedMessages += 1;
166	            continue;
167	        }
168	
169	        cleanedMessages += 1;
170	        cleanedMessagesList.push(cleaned);
171	    }
172	
173	    return { messages: cleanedMessagesList, deletedMessages, cleanedMessages };
174	}

176	function collectMascotToolCallIds(msg: MascotMsg): Set<string> {
177	    const ids = new Set<string>();
178	    if (msg.toolCallId) ids.add(msg.toolCallId);
179	    for (const call of msg.toolCalls || []) {
180	        if (call.id) ids.add(call.id);
181	    }
182	    return ids;

185	function removeToolCallsFromMascotMessage(msg: MascotMsg, idsToRemove: Set<string>): {
186	    message: MascotMsg | null;
187	    cleaned: boolean;
188	} {
189	    if (!msg.toolCalls?.length) return { message: msg, cleaned: false };
190	
191	    const keptToolCalls = msg.toolCalls.filter((call) => !idsToRemove.has(call.id));
192	    if (keptToolCalls.length === msg.toolCalls.length) return { message: msg, cleaned: false };
193	
194	    const cleaned: MascotMsg = { ...msg };
195	    if (keptToolCalls.length > 0) {
196	        cleaned.toolCalls = keptToolCalls;
197	    } else {
198	        delete cleaned.toolCalls;
199	    }
200	
201	    if (!hasVisibleMascotPayload(cleaned) && !cleaned.toolCalls?.length) {
202	        return { message: null, cleaned: true };
203	    }
204	
205	    return { message: cleaned, cleaned: true };
206	}

208	export function deleteMascotMessageWithLinkedTools(
209	    nextMessages: MascotMsg[],
210	    rawIndex: number,
211	): DeleteMascotMessageWithLinkedToolsResult {
212	    const target = nextMessages[rawIndex];
213	    if (!target) return { messages: nextMessages, deletedMessages: 0, cleanedMessages: 0 };
214	
215	    const idsToRemove = collectMascotToolCallIds(target);
216	    const indexesToDelete = new Set<number>([rawIndex]);
217	    const replacements = new Map<number, MascotMsg>();
218	    let cleanedMessages = 0;
219	
220	    if (idsToRemove.size > 0) {
221	        nextMessages.forEach((msg, index) => {
222	            if (index !== rawIndex && msg.role === "tool" && msg.toolCallId && idsToRemove.has(msg.toolCallId)) {
223	                indexesToDelete.add(index);
224	                return;
225	            }
226	
227	            if (index !== rawIndex && msg.role === "mascot" && msg.toolCalls?.length) {
228	                const result = removeToolCallsFromMascotMessage(msg, idsToRemove);
229	                if (!result.cleaned) return;
230	                cleanedMessages += 1;
231	                if (result.message) {
232	                    replacements.set(index, result.message);
233	                } else {
234	                    indexesToDelete.add(index);
235	                }
236	            }
237	        });
238	    } else if (target.role === "mascot") {
239	        for (let i = rawIndex + 1; i < nextMessages.length; i += 1) {
240	            const msg = nextMessages[i];
241	            if (msg.role !== "tool") break;
242	            if (msg.toolCallId) break;
243	            indexesToDelete.add(i);
244	        }
245	    } else if (target.role === "tool") {
246	        for (let i = rawIndex - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
247	            const msg = nextMessages[i];
248	            if (msg.role === "tool") continue;
249	            if (msg.role === "mascot" && !hasVisibleMascotPayload(msg)) indexesToDelete.add(i);
250	            break;
251	        }
252	    }
253	
254	    let deletedMessages = 0;
255	    const messagesAfterDelete: MascotMsg[] = [];
256	    nextMessages.forEach((msg, index) => {
257	        if (indexesToDelete.has(index)) {
258	            deletedMessages += 1;
259	            return;
260	        }
261	        messagesAfterDelete.push(replacements.get(index) || msg);
262	    });
263	
264	    return { messages: messagesAfterDelete, deletedMessages, cleanedMessages };
265	}

392	export async function hydrateMascotChat(): Promise<void> {
393	    if (hydrated) return;
394	    if (hydratePromise) return hydratePromise;
395	    hydratePromise = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
396	        const finishWithMessages = (loaded: MascotMsg[], migrated: boolean) => {
397	            const greeting = loaded.length > 0 ? null : defaultGreetingMessage();
398	            messages = greeting ? [greeting] : loaded;
399	            const now = Date.now();
400	            const session: MascotSession = {
401	                id: makeMascotSessionId(),
402	                title: migrated && loaded.length > 0 ? "之前的对话" : "新对话",
403	                createdAt: now,
404	                updatedAt: now,
405	                messages,
406	            };
407	            sessions = [session];
408	            activeSessionId = session.id;
409	            hydrated = true;
410	            persistState();
411	            emit();
412	            resolve();
413	        };
414	
415	        if (typeof indexedDB === "undefined") {
416	            finishWithMessages([], false);
417	            return;
418	        }
419	        const req = openMascotDb();
420	        req.onsuccess = () => {
421	            try {
422	                if (!req.result.objectStoreNames.contains(MASCOT_CHAT_STORE)) {
423	                    req.result.close();
424	                    finishWithMessages([], false);
425	                    return;
426	                }
427	                const tx = req.result.transaction(MASCOT_CHAT_STORE, "readonly");
428	                const store = tx.objectStore(MASCOT_CHAT_STORE);
429	                const stateGet = store.get(MASCOT_STATE_KEY);
430	                stateGet.onsuccess = () => {
431	                    const state = stateGet.result as PersistedMascotState | undefined;
432	                    if (state && Array.isArray(state.sessions) && state.sessions.length > 0) {
433	                        sessions = state.sessions
434	                            .filter((session) => session && typeof session.id === "string" && Array.isArray(session.messages))
435	                            .map((session) => ({ ...session, messages: normalizeMessages(session.messages) }))
436	                            .sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt - a.updatedAt)
437	                            .slice(0, MAX_MASCOT_SESSIONS);
438	                        activeSessionId = state.activeSessionId && sessions.some((session) => session.id === state.activeSessionId)
439	                            ? state.activeSessionId
440	                            : sessions[0]?.id ?? null;
441	                        messages = sessions.find((session) => session.id === activeSessionId)?.messages ?? [];
442	                        hydrated = true;
443	                        emit();
444	                        req.result.close();
445	                        resolve();
446	                        return;
447	                    }
448	
449	                    // 首次升级：保留旧键，并将旧版单会话记录复制进多会话 state。
450	                    const legacyGet = store.get(MASCOT_MESSAGES_KEY);
451	                    legacyGet.onsuccess = () => {
452	                        const loaded = Array.isArray(legacyGet.result) ? normalizeMessages(legacyGet.result) : [];
453	                        req.result.close();
454	                        finishWithMessages(loaded, loaded.length > 0);
455	                    };
456	                    legacyGet.onerror = () => {
457	                        req.result.close();
458	                        finishWithMessages([], false);
459	                    };
460	                };
461	                stateGet.onerror = () => {
462	                    req.result.close();
463	                    finishWithMessages([], false);
464	                };
465	            } catch {
466	                try { req.result.close(); } catch {}
467	                finishWithMessages([], false);
468	            }
469	        };
470	        req.onerror = () => finishWithMessages([], false);
471	    });
472	    return hydratePromise;
473	}

505	export async function generateMascotReply({
506	    context = getMascotContext(),
507	}: {
508	    context?: MascotPageContext;
509	} = {}): Promise<void> {
510	    await hydrateMascotChat();
511	    if (isThinking) return;
512	    const latestVisibleMessage = [...messages].reverse().find((msg) => !msg.hidden && msg.role !== "tool");
513	    if (latestVisibleMessage?.role !== "user") return;
514	
515	    let workingMessages = normalizeMessages(messages);
516	    setThinking(true);
517	
518	    const MAX_ROUNDS = 8;
519	    abortRequested = false;
520	    const controller = new AbortController();
521	    abortController = controller;
522	    let expandedPackageIds = loadExpandedPackages();
523	    // 每次用户发送消息就是一次独立任务；最多 8 轮工具调用共享同一备份集合。
524	    const toolCtx: MascotToolContext = {
525	        pageContext: context,
526	        history: workingMessages,
527	        characterBackupIds: new Set<string>(),
528	    };
529	
530	    try {
531	        for (let round = 0; round < MAX_ROUNDS; round += 1) {
532	            if (abortRequested) break;
533	
534	            let streamedDisplay = "";
535	            let lastStreamPaintAt = 0;
536	            let lastStreamPaintLength = 0;
537	            const streamToolIds = new Set<string>();
538	            const streamToolMessages: MascotMsg[] = [];
539	            const paintStream = async (force = false) => {
540	                const now = Date.now();
541	                if (!force && streamedDisplay.length - lastStreamPaintLength < 12 && now - lastStreamPaintAt < 50) return;
542	                lastStreamPaintAt = now;
543	                lastStreamPaintLength = streamedDisplay.length;
544	                const liveItems: MascotMsg[] = [];
545	                if (streamedDisplay.trim()) {
546	                    liveItems.push({
547	                        role: "mascot",
548	                        text: streamedDisplay,
549	                        displayText: streamedDisplay,
550	                        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
551	                    });
552	                }
553	                liveItems.push(...streamToolMessages.map(withTimestamp));
554	                publishMessages([...workingMessages, ...liveItems], { persist: false });
555	                await new Promise<void>((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve()));
556	            };
557	
558	            const response = await mascotChatWithTools(
559	                context,
560	                workingMessages,
561	                expandedPackageIds,
562	                {
563	                    signal: controller.signal,
564	                    callbacks: {
565	                        async onAssistantDelta(delta) {
566	                            if (!delta) return;
567	                            streamedDisplay += delta;
568	                            await paintStream(false);
569	                        },
570	                        async onToolCallStart(info) {
571	                            if (streamToolIds.has(info.id)) return;
572	                            streamToolIds.add(info.id);
573	                            streamToolMessages.push({
574	                                role: "tool",
575	                                text: "",
576	                                hidden: false,
577	                                displayText: `正在调用 ${info.name}…`,
578	                                toolName: info.name,
579	                                toolDisplayName: info.name,
580	                                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
581	                            });
582	                            await paintStream(true);
583	                        },
584	                        async onStreamFallback(reason) {
585	                            console.warn("[Mascot] 流式输出不可用，已切换普通生成:", reason);
586	                        },
587	                    },
588	                },
589	            );
590	            if (streamedDisplay) await paintStream(true);
591	
592	            const displayReply = response.reply.join("\n");
593	            const assistantMsg: MascotMsg = {
594	                role: "mascot",
595	                text: response.rawAssistant,
596	                displayText: displayReply || (response.toolCalls.length > 0 || response.toolFetches.length > 0 ? "（调用工具中...）" : "（无内容）"),
597	                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
598	            };
599	            if (response.protocol === "native" && response.nativeToolCalls && response.nativeToolCalls.length > 0) {
600	                assistantMsg.toolCalls = response.nativeToolCalls;
601	            }
602	            if (response.protocol === "native" && response.reasoning) {
603	                assistantMsg.reasoning = response.reasoning;
604	            }
605	            if (response.protocol === "native" && response.openRouterReasoningDetails?.length) {
606	                assistantMsg.openRouterReasoningDetails = response.openRouterReasoningDetails;
607	            }
608	            workingMessages = normalizeMessages([...workingMessages, assistantMsg]);
609	            publishMessages(workingMessages);
610	
611	            if (response.toolFetches.length > 0) {
612	                for (const fetch of response.toolFetches) {
613	                    const pkg = findPackageByLabel(fetch.name);
614	                    if (!pkg) continue;
615	                    expandedPackageIds = touchExpandedPackage(expandedPackageIds, pkg.id);
616	                    saveExpandedPackages(expandedPackageIds);
617	
618	                    const guideContent = `「${pkg.label}」已展开，详细动作如下：\n${buildMascotPackageSchemaPrompt(pkg.label, response.protocol)}`;
619	
620	                    if (response.protocol === "native") {
621	                        const loaderName = getMascotNativeLoaderName(pkg.id);
622	                        const loaderCall = response.nativeToolCalls?.find((call) => call.name === loaderName);
623	                        workingMessages = normalizeMessages([...workingMessages, {
624	                            role: "tool",
625	                            text: guideContent,
626	                            hidden: false,
627	                            displayText: `展开「${pkg.label}」工具集`,
628	                            toolCallId: loaderCall?.id || "",
629	                            toolName: loaderCall?.name || loaderName,
630	                            toolDisplayName: `展开${pkg.label}`,
631	                            toolSuccess: true,
632	                            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
633	                        }]);
634	                    } else {
635	                        workingMessages = normalizeMessages([...workingMessages, {
636	                            role: "tool",
637	                            text: guideContent,
638	                            hidden: false,
639	                            displayText: `展开「${pkg.label}」工具集`,
640	                            toolName: `展开${pkg.label}`,
641	                            toolDisplayName: `展开${pkg.label}`,
642	                            toolSuccess: true,
643	                            createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
644	                        }]);
645	                    }
646	                    publishMessages(workingMessages);
647	                }
648	                continue;
649	            }
650	
651	            if (response.toolCalls.length > 0) {
652	                for (let i = 0; i < response.toolCalls.length; i += 1) {
653	                    const call = response.toolCalls[i];
654	                    const nativeCall = response.protocol === "native"
655	                        ? response.nativeToolCalls?.[i]
656	                        : undefined;
657	                    const displayName = call.name;
658	                    const protocolName = nativeCall?.name || call.name;
659	
660	                    const runningMessage: MascotMsg = {
661	                        role: "tool",
662	                        text: "",
663	                        hidden: false,
664	                        displayText: `正在调用 ${displayName}…`,
665	                        toolName: protocolName,
666	                        toolDisplayName: displayName,
667	                        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
668	                    };
669	                    workingMessages = normalizeMessages([...workingMessages, runningMessage]);
670	                    const runningIdx = workingMessages.length - 1;
671	                    publishMessages(workingMessages);
672	                    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve()));
673	
674	                    // 复用同一上下文，确保多轮工具调用共享角色备份状态。
675	                    toolCtx.history = workingMessages;
676	                    const result = await executeMascotToolCall(call, toolCtx);
677	                    if (result.success) mascotFillField({ field: call.name, value: result.data || "" });
678	
679	                    const resultText = result.success ? (result.data || "完成") : (result.error || "未知错误");
680	                    const updated = [...workingMessages];
681	                    updated[runningIdx] = {
682	                        role: "tool",
683	                        text: resultText,
684	                        hidden: false,
685	                        displayText: resultText,
686	                        images: result.mediaAttachments?.filter((attachment) => attachment.type === "image").map((attachment) => attachment.url),
687	                        toolCallId: nativeCall?.id || "",
688	                        toolName: protocolName,
689	                        toolDisplayName: displayName,
690	                        toolSuccess: result.success,
691	                        createdAt: updated[runningIdx]?.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
692	                    };
693	                    workingMessages = normalizeMessages(updated);
694	                    publishMessages(workingMessages);
695	                }
696	                continue;
697	            }
698	
699	            break;
700	        }
701	
702	        if (abortRequested) {
703	            publishMessages([...workingMessages, { role: "user", text: "[用户中止了操作]", hidden: false, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }]);
704	        }
705	        if (!isMascotPanelOpen() && typeof window !== "undefined") {
706	            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("global-notice", { detail: abortRequested ? "操作已中止" : "AI助手已完成操作 ✓" }));
707	        }
708	    } catch (err) {
709	        if ((err as Error).name !== "AbortError" && !abortRequested) {
710	            publishMessages([...workingMessages, { role: "mascot", text: `出错了...${(err as Error).message}`, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }]);
711	            if (!isMascotPanelOpen() && typeof window !== "undefined") {
712	                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("global-notice", { detail: "AI助手生成失败了..." }));
713	            }
714	        }
715	    } finally {
716	        setThinking(false);
717	        abortController = null;
718	    }
719	}
